content: अभिवद् €1 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To speak to, address; परस्त्रियं योऽभिवदेत्तीर्थेऽरण्ये वनेऽपि वा <ls>Ms. 8. 356</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 301</ls>. .²2 To speak of or with reference to, tell, declare, mention; यत्कर्म क्रियमाणम् ऋगभिवदति <ls>Ait. Br.</ls> .²3 To express, utter, signify; यद्वाचाऽनभ्युदितं येन वागभ्युद्यते . तदेव ब्रह्म त्वं विद्धि नेदं यदिदमुपासते <ls>Ken. 1. 4</ls>. .²4 To name, call. .²5 To salute, greet; see {%<ab>caus.</ab>%}; --{%<ab>caus.</ab>%} .²1 To greet or salute respectfully, <ab>oft.</ab> with the mention of the person saluted and the person who salutes; तात प्राचेतसान्तेवासी लवोऽभिवादयते <ls>U. 6</ls>. भगवन्नभिवादये <ls>V. 5</ls>; see अभिवाद also. .²2 To cause to salute (with <ab>acc.</ab> or <ab>instr.</ab> of agent of action); अभिवादयते देवं भक्तं भक्तेन वा. .²3 To utter, pronounce. .²4 To play on an instrument.
